o1: Enables insulin-like growth factor receptor binding activity; mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase binding activity; and mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase binding activity. Predicted to enable phosphotyrosine binding. Involved in positive regulation of axon regeneration; response to endoplasmic reticulum stress; response to metal ion; insulin receptor signaling pathway; MAPK cascade; determination of adult lifespan; defense response to bacterium; entry into dauer diapause; and multiple stress responses including oxidative stress, heat, and starvation. Is located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and reproductive system. Is part of the insulin receptor signaling pathway; MAPK cascade. Orthologous to several human genes including SHC4 (SHC adaptor protein 4).
